title: Q3 Retro — With the Insights Tool

went_well.author: dana
went_well.text: My talk-time dropped from ~66% to under 40% once the tool started nudging me.

went_well.author: naomi
went_well.text: Round-robin + pre-reads: I actually speak in meetings now. Contribution is visible.

went_well.author: ben
went_well.text: Caught a regression and announced it the same hour. No 4-day silence.

went_well.author: marcus
went_well.text: Dissent lands in the room before decisions now — the tool shows the timing.

went_poorly.author: james
went_poorly.text: The tool over-flagged one quiet week as 'low engagement' — we tuned the threshold.

went_poorly.author: mark
went_poorly.text: I still default to async first; working on it, but better than the hallway.

try_next.author: sarah
try_next.text: Roll the insights tool out to the two partner districts' teams.

try_next.author: dana
try_next.text: Publish the before/after so other Alaska teams can use it.
